Subject Enquiries re Hwa Kuh Ts (華克之).

Made by D.S.I. Coyne Forwarded by **〔签名〕**

With reference to the attached report on the subject of
the formation of a special squad of detectives for the
purpose of continuing investigations into the Japanese murder
cases, this squad, consisting of C.D.S. 114 Wong Ching Sung
(王金聲), C.D.S. 163 Zia Foh Daung(謝福棠) and C.D.S. 320
Chang Yoong Sheng(張榮生), has now commenced to function.

These detectives were instructed to locate the mother of
Ching Dao Joen(金道权) who was sentenced to 13 years'
imprisonment at the Shanghai District Court on December 28,
1936 on charges arising out of the murder of A. Kayawo on
July 10, 1936.

It was believed probable that Hwa Kuh Ts would send money
to this woman, as he was a fellow countryman and a family
friend, and Ching Dao Joen was supporting her up to the time
of his arrest.

This woman has now been found residing in a straw hut in
Chapei, and a watch is being kept on her and persons calling
on her.

With a view to locating persons to whom Hwa Kuh Ts might
be known, Crime Report 846/32, Sinza, dealing with the arrest
of a labour union assassination gang was obtained, and from
it were taken the names of 14 persons. Of these several were
found to be frequenting their old haunts in Pootoo Road
District and when questioned by the detectives stated that
they knew Hwa Kuh Ts, he having been engaged in labour union
activities in the western district several years ago. With
the assistance of these men efforts are now being made to
locate Hwa, who is reported to be living at Siccawei.

由副督察长科因（Coyne）制作 转呈 **〔签名〕**

鉴于所附关于组建一支特别侦探小队以继续调查日本人被杀案的报告，该小队由刑事侦探警士114号王金聲、刑事侦探警士163号謝福棠和刑事侦探警士320号張榮生组成，现已开始运作。

这些侦探受命寻找金道权（Ching Dao Joen）的母亲，金道权因涉及1936年7月10日谋杀A. Kayawo一案，于1936年12月28日被上海地方法院判处13年监禁。

据信华克之很可能会给这名妇女汇款，因为他是同乡兼世交，且金道权在被捕前一直供养着她。

现已查明该妇女居住在闸北的一间草棚内，正对其及来访者进行监视。

为了寻找可能认识华克之的人员，调取了关于逮捕工会暗杀团伙的第846/32号罪案报告（Sinza），从中提取了14人的姓名。其中几人被发现经常出没于普陀路地区的旧据点，经侦探讯问时称他们认识华克之，他几年前曾在西区从事工会活动。在这些人的协助下，目前正努力寻找华克之的下落，据报他住在徐家汇。

Subject Anti-Japanese Incidents.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Coyne

* A.7045
* A.7198

Forwarded herewith is a review of the political situation,
with comments on political activities, at the times when
Japanese subjects were murdered in Shanghai. In connection
with this it will be necessary to include comment on the attempt
on the life of H.E. Wang Ching Wei and the murder of Mr. Tang
Yu Jen (唐有壬), as it is believed in some quarters that these
cases were committed by those responsible for the murders of
the Japanese.

The first of these cases occurred on November 1, 1935,
when at the opening of the 6th Plenary Session of the Kuomintang
in Nanking an attempt was made on the life of H.E. Wang Ching
Wei, President of the Executive Yuan and Minister of Foreign
Affairs. Although seriously wounded His Excellency recovered,
and early in 1936, he departed for Europe, ostensibly for
further medical treatment.

This attempt was made when Kuomintang leaders were posing
for a group photograph, and the Generalissimo, although present
at the meeting, had decided not to take his seat next to His
Excellency as he was suffering from toothache. A number of
persons have been taken into custody for this offence, and
from statements made by them to the Nanking Metropolitan Police,
it would appear that the plot was hatched by members of the
South West Clique and carried out by the organization of one
known as Wong Yah Jao (王亞樵). Two reasons for the attempted
murder were put forward, the first being that Mr. Wang was
pro-Japanese, the second that he had betrayed his former
supporters. Either of these reasons in the opinion of certain
cliques would be considered sufficient justification for his
removal from the sphere of political influence, but although

第一起案件发生在1935年11月1日，当时在南京召开的国民党第六届中央全会开幕式上，有人企图刺杀行政院院长兼外交部长汪精卫阁下。虽然汪阁下身受重伤，但得以康复，并于1936年初前往欧洲，名义上是去接受进一步的治疗。

这次刺杀发生在国民党领导人拍摄集体照时，总司令虽然出席了会议，但因牙痛决定不坐在汪阁下旁边。已有数人因此罪行被拘留，根据他们向南京首都警察厅所作的陈述，阴谋似乎是由西南派成员策划，并由一个名为王亚樵的组织执行的。提出了两个行刺理由，一是汪先生亲日，二是他背叛了以前的支持者。在某些派系看来，这两个理由中的任何一个都足以成为将其清除出政治影响力范围的理由，尽管

the reason does not particularly concern us in relation to
this case it does with reference to the subsequent murders.
It will be recalled that following the Wuhan split in
1928, when General Chiang Kai Shek suppressed the left wing
of the Kuomintang and chased out of the country his Soviet
advisors, the South West Clique, headed by Mr. Wang Ching
Wei, and supported by Mr. Sun Fo, Generals Chen Chi Tang,
Chen Ming Chu, Pei Tsung Hsi and Li Tsung Jen, came into
being. This group had a definite pro-Soviet tendency, and
was opposed to General Chiang Kai Shek on both personal and
political grounds. In September 1930, Mr. Wang Ching Wei,
General Feng Yu Hsiang and General Yen Hsi San formed the
Northern Coalition Government, the collapse of which was
brought about by Marshal Chang Hsueh Liang. This ill advised
move resulted in General Feng spending two years as a guest
of the Soviet Union and General Yen retiring to a monastery
in his native province, but it was not long before Mr. Wang,
as the nominee of the South West Clique, was in the Cabinet
of his former enemy, General Chiang. This rapprochement far
from pleased General Feng, who on his return was forced to
accept the comparatively unimportant post of Vice Chairman
of the Military Affairs Commission and become virtually a
prisoner in Nanking. (So much so that when he recently left
Nanking for the first time to visit Hangchow, the Generalissimo
provided 500 of his personal bodyguards.)
When Mr. Wang took up his appointment at Nanking it was
believed that he would rapidly find posts with the Central
Government for other members of the South West Clique, but
when he failed to do so he was accused of being a traitor.

这一理由与本案关系不大，但与随后的谋杀案有关。
回想一下，继1928年武汉分裂之后，当蒋介石将军镇压国民党左派并将苏联顾问驱逐出境时，以汪精卫先生为首，孙科先生、陈济棠将军、陈铭枢将军、裴宗锡（Pei Tsung Hsi，音译）将军和李宗仁将军支持的西南派应运而生。该团体具有明显的亲苏倾向，并在个人和政治层面上反对蒋介石将军。1930年9月，汪精卫先生、冯玉祥将军和阎锡山将军组成了北方联合政府，其垮台是由张学良元帅促成的。这一不明智的举动导致冯将军在苏联做了两年的客卿，阎将军退隐到其家乡省份的一座寺庙中，但不久之后，汪先生作为西南派的提名人，进入了其昔日敌人蒋介石将军的内阁。这种和解远未让冯将军高兴，他回国后被迫接受军事委员会副委员长这一相对不重要的职位，实际上成为南京的囚徒。（以至于当他最近首次离开南京访问杭州时，总司令提供了500名贴身保镖。）
当汪先生赴南京就职时，人们相信他会迅速为西南派的其他成员在中央政府找到职位，但当他未能做到时，他被指责为叛徒。

His clique failed to realize that Mr. Wang had become a puppet
in Nanking, just as he had been a puppet in Canton, and that
he was to all intents and purposes a prisoner of Nanking.
General Feng Yu Hsiang, essentially a soldierman, still
has a strong following in the army, and although his activities
were restricted he was by no means isolated, for he was in
sympathy with the anti-Japanese sentiments of his old friends
of 1924, when he was in Canton, namely, Chen Chi Tang, Pei
Tsung Hsi and Li Tsung Jen. It is not surprising, therefore,
that we find operating from Hongkong a group of terrorists
composed mainly of officers formerly in personal contact
with General Feng when he commanded an independent army.
About one year ago the formation of an anti-Japanese force
was suggested by the communist armies in China, and there is
every reason to believe that a Sino-Soviet alliance was
suggested through other channels. Soviet agents visited Canton
and the clamour of the South West Clique for action against the
Japanese in North China became so embarrassing to the Nanking
Government that it was decided that the source of the clamour
be eliminated. General Chiang made preparations to take
A. 7280 military action when it was found that Chen Chi Tang's figure
for "provincial subsidy" was more than Nanking could afford to
pay. Acting on the advice of his former chief, General Hsu,
General Chiang bought over a number of the followers of Chen
Chi Tang and Pei Tsung Hsi, - including their air forces,-
and this brought about their downfall. General Chen, who
owns several millions of dollars worth of property in Hongkong,
agreed to accept a round-the-world trip from Nanking, but
Generals Pei and Li both refused to accept their appointments

他的派系未能意识到，汪先生已成为南京的傀儡，就像他曾在广州是傀儡一样，而且他在各方面实际上都是南京的囚徒。
冯玉祥将军本质上是一名军人，在军队中仍拥有强大的追随者，虽然他的活动受到限制，但他绝非孤立无援，因为他同情1924年在广州时的老朋友们的反日情绪，即陈济棠、裴宗锡（Pei Tsung Hsi，音译）和李宗仁。因此，我们发现一个主要由以前与冯将军指挥独立军时有私人接触的军官组成的恐怖分子团体在香港活动，这并不奇怪。
大约一年前，中国的共产党军队建议组建一支反日部队，且有充分理由相信通过其他渠道提出了中苏联盟的建议。苏联特工访问了广州，西南派要求在华北对日本采取行动的呼声变得令南京政府如此尴尬，以至于决定消除这一呼声的来源。当发现陈济棠要求的“省级补贴”数额超过南京所能支付的限度时，蒋介石将军准备采取军事行动（A. 7280）。蒋将军听从其前任上司许将军的建议，收买了陈济棠和裴宗锡的部分追随者——包括他们的空军——这导致了他们的垮台。陈将军在香港拥有价值数百万美元的财产，同意接受南京提供的环球旅行，但裴将军和李将军都拒绝接受他们的任命

Commission respectively and are still in Kwangsi. General Li,

strong following in Nanking military circles, and he and General
Teng strongly influence the Fascist Party, which now controls
the activities of the left wing of the Blue Shirts.
Organizations engaged in Political Murder.
In recent years there have been two organizations
actively engaged in political murders, the Chinese Communist
Party and the Blue Shirts, a militant fascist section of the
Kuomintang.
Concerning the Communist Party, there is no record of
their assassination squad having been responsible for the
murder of any person other than renegade members of the Party
who, by virtue of their knowledge of party affairs, have given
their services to those engaged in the suppression of communism.
During the past two or three years even these persons do not
appear to have been so drastically dealt with, at least not in
the Shanghai area.
Regarding the Blue Shirt organization, although the
existence of such a group has frequently been denied by the
Kuomintang, persons familiar with the internal affairs of
various political factions believe that the Blue Shirts have,
during the last three years, played an important part in Party
affairs. This group, it has been alleged, carried out the
assassination of Yang An Ver(楊杏佛), Sz Liang Zai(史量才),

分别致浙江省政府及军事委员会，目前仍在广西。李将军据称是中国最能干的军事领袖之一，在南京军界拥有强大的追随者，他和邓将军对法西斯党派有着强烈的影响，该党派目前控制着蓝衣社左翼的活动。
从事政治谋杀的组织。
近年来，有两个组织积极从事政治谋杀活动，即中国共产党和蓝衣社，后者是国民党内一个好战的法西斯派系。
关于共产党，没有记录显示其暗杀小队曾负责谋杀除叛变党员以外的任何人，这些叛变党员凭借其掌握的党务知识，为从事镇压共产主义活动的人提供服务。在过去两三年里，即使是这些人似乎也没有受到如此严厉的处置，至少在上海地区是这样。
关于蓝衣社组织，尽管国民党经常否认此类团体的存在，但熟悉各政治派别内部事务的人士认为，蓝衣社在过去三年中在党务中发挥了重要作用。据称，该组织实施了对杨杏佛（Yang An Ver）、史量才（Sz Liang Zai）、唐有壬（Tang Yu Jen）的暗杀，而左翼则负责对杨永泰（Yang Yoong Tai）的谋杀。

arrests were made, and although the assassin in the Yang
Yoong Tai case was arrested, as yet none of the instigators
of the crime have been taken into custody. It is worthy of
note that in each of these murders the assailants carried
their firearms away with them.
The Murder of Japanese in the Settlement.
    (1) On November 9, 1935 a Japanese sailor was murdered
on Darroch Road, (2) on July 10, 1936 a Japanese civilian
was murdered on Chi Mei Road, (3) on September 23, 1936, a
Japanese sailor was murdered on Haining Road and (4) on
November 11, 1936 a Japanese civilian was murdered on Baikal
Road. These cases had much in common, it will be noted that :-
    1. These four murders were committed between 8 and 9 p.m.
    2. In case 1, 3 and 4, the firearm was discarded near the
scene. In case No. 2 it was hidden in a creek two miles
from the scene.
    3. In each case the murder was carried out either in or
very close to an alleyway, enabling the assassin to
escape without being clearly seen.
    4. In each case the shooting proved effective, the assassin
evidently being an expert shot.
    5. Each murder was committed when the political situation
was tense and important decisions were about to be made.
* Wong Yah Jao (王亚樵)
    Wong Yah Jao, a native of Anhwei, first came to the
notice of the Shanghai public when he shot and killed Zee Kuo
Liang (徐国梁), Chief of the Woosung-Shanghai Constabulary, on
Yunnan Road in 1924. The murder was the result of a squabble
between the military forces of Chekiang and Kiangsu regarding

租界内日本人被谋杀案。
    (1) 1935年11月9日，一名日本水手在达罗克路（Darroch Road）被谋杀，(2) 1936年7月10日，一名日本平民在集美路（Chi Mei Road）被谋杀，(3) 1936年9月23日，一名日本水手在海宁路（Haining Road）被谋杀，以及 (4) 1936年11月11日，一名日本平民在贝加尔路（Baikal Road）被谋杀。这些案件有许多共同点，值得注意的是：-
    1. 这四起谋杀案均发生在晚上8点至9点之间。
    2. 在第1、3和4案中，枪支被丢弃在案发现场附近。在第2案中，枪支被藏在距离现场两英里的一条小河沟里。
    3. 在每起案件中，谋杀都是在弄堂内或非常靠近弄堂的地方实施的，使刺客能够逃脱而不被清楚看见。
    4. 在每起案件中，枪击都证明是有效的，刺客显然是一名神枪手。
    5. 每起谋杀案都发生在政治局势紧张且即将做出重要决定之时。

the sale of opium in Shanghai which terminated in a war between
the two provinces. At that time Wong Yah Jao was a gangster
engaged in armed robbery and kidnapping, but in 1926-7 he came
to the fore in connection with the activities of the Labour
Union in the Western District.
        Under his direction his followers murdered Mr. Chow Ti
Chao(趙鐵橋), the Managing Director of the China Merchants
Steam Navigation Company, carried out an attempt on the life
of Mr. T. V. Soong, Minister of Finance, and plotted an attempt
on the lives of members of the League of Nations Commission
which was in Shanghai after the Manchurian Incident.
        During the Sino-Japanese affair of 1932 Wong was active
in the formation of volunteer units in Shanghai and it was at
this time that he became acquainted with Tsang Ts Lee(張志),
the organizer of "The Blood and Soul Group."
        Between 1932 and 1936 very little was heard of Wong, but
when several persons were arrested in connection with the
attempt on the life of Mr. Wang Ching Wei, it transpired that
they had been working on the instructions of Wong Yah Jao,
who was then residing in Hongkong. One of these accused,
Tsang Yu Hwa(張玉華) alias Tsang Ts Ming(張世明), told the
Court in Nanking that Wong Yah Jao ordered the attempt on the
life of Mr. Wang Ching Wei at the instigation of General Chen
Ming Chu and General Li Chi Sen.
        Tsang Yu Hwa was brought from Nanking in August 1936 and
was identified by a number of men - some of whom admitted being
responsible for the Kayao case, and others who admitted being
concerned in the Nakayama case - as having directed the
activities of the gang together with Hwa Kuh Ts(華克之). Of

在上海贩卖鸦片而发生争执，最终导致两省之间的战争。当时，王亚樵是一名从事武装抢劫和绑架的匪徒，但在1926-7年间，他因与西区工会的活动有关而崭露头角。
        在他的指使下，其追随者谋杀了招商局总经理赵铁桥（Chow Ti Chao）先生，企图刺杀财政部长宋子文（T. V. Soong）先生，并策划企图刺杀九一八事变后在上海的国际联盟调查团成员。
        在1932年的中日冲突期间，王积极参与上海义勇军的组建，正是在这一时期，他结识了“铁血团”组织者张志（Tsang Ts Lee）。
        1932年至1936年间，很少听到关于王的消息，但当数人因企图刺杀汪精卫（Wang Ching Wei）先生而被捕时，事实证明他们是在当时居住在香港的王亚樵的指令下行事的。其中一名被告张玉华（Tsang Yu Hwa），化名张世明（Tsang Ts Ming），在南京法庭上称，王亚樵是在陈铭枢（Chen Ming Chu）将军和李济深（Li Chi Sen）将军的唆使下下令企图刺杀汪精卫先生的。
        张玉华于1936年8月从南京被带来，并被许多人指认——其中一些人承认对加藤（Kayao）案负责，另一些人承认参与中山（Nakayama）案——指认他与华克之（Hwa Kuh Ts）共同指挥该团伙的活动。其中

Incidents and Political Events occurring
immediately before the undermentioned
Anti-Japanese incidents.

(1) Darroch Road Murder Case (9.11.1935).

Nov. 1 - Opening of the 6th Plenary Session of the
Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang
at Nanking.

" 1 - Attempted assassination of Mr. Wang Ching Wei.

" 7 - Hsiangho Incident occurred in Hsiangho Hsien,
near Peiping, which eventually led to the
formation of the East Hopei Autonomous Govt.

" 4 - Reform of the New Currency Scheme.

Oct. 30 - Arrest of Li Min, Chief of the 2nd Department
of the Tientsin Bureau of Social Affairs, by
the Japanese army.

(2) Chi Mei Road Murder Case (10.7.36).

July 8 - The case against Yang Vung Dao et al was heard
at the Shanghai Special District Court and
was ordered to be remanded till the 10.7.36.

" 10 - 2nd Cabinet meeting at Nanking to discuss
Sino-Japanese relations.

(3) Chengtu Incident (24.8.36).

Incident took place following a mass meeting held by
the Chengtu people as a protest against the reported
intention of opening a Japanese Consulate at Chengtu;

(4) Pakhoi Incident (3.9.36)

During the time when the 19th Route Army stationed in
Pakhoi was advocating military action against Japan.

(5) Hankow Incident (19.9.36)

Following the Fengtai incident which occurred on
18.9.36 when a clash between Japanese and the 29th
Route Army soldiers occurred. (Fengtai is situated
near Peiping.)

(6) Haining Road Murder (23.9.36).

17.9.36 - Arrest of Wang Tsen Sung in connection with
the Kayau Murder Case by the Public Safety
Bureau.

22.9.36 - The date set for the trial of Yang Vung Dao
et al was announced by the Shanghai Special
District Court.

(7) Taiyuan Incident (26.10.36)

17.10.36 - Arrival in Hangchow of General Hsu Yung
Chong, Pacification Commissioner of Shansi
Province, for conference.

20.10.36 - Suiyuan situation became tense.
page_data.zh:
在下述反日事件发生前夕发生的事件和政治事件。

(1) 达罗克路谋杀案 (1935年11月9日)。

11月1日 - 国民党第六届中央执行委员会全体会议在南京开幕。

" 1日 - 企图刺杀汪精卫先生。

" 7日 - 香河事件发生在北平附近的香河县，最终导致冀东自治政府的成立。

" 4日 - 法币改革方案实施。

10月30日 - 天津社会局第二科科长李敏被日军逮捕。

(2) 集美路谋杀案 (1936年7月10日)。

7月8日 - 上海特区地方法院审理杨勇道（Yang Vung Dao）等人案件，并命令延期至1936年7月10日。

" 10日 - 南京召开第二次内阁会议，讨论中日关系。

(3) 成都事件 (1936年8月24日)。

该事件发生在成都民众举行大规模集会之后，以抗议据报道将在成都开设日本领事馆的意图；

(4) 北海事件 (1936年9月3日)

发生在驻扎在北海的第十九路军主张对日采取军事行动期间。

(5) 汉口事件 (1936年9月19日)

继1936年9月18日发生的丰台事件之后，当时日军与第二十九军士兵发生冲突。（丰台位于北平附近。）

(6) 海宁路谋杀案 (1936年9月23日)。

1936年9月17日 - 公安局逮捕与加藤（Kayau）谋杀案有关的王森松（Wang Tsen Sung）。

1936年9月22日 - 上海特区地方法院宣布审理杨勇道等人案件的日期。

(7) 太原事件 (1936年10月26日)

1936年10月17日 - 山西省绥靖主任徐永昌（Hsu Yung Chong）将军抵达杭州参加会议。

1936年10月20日 - 绥远局势变得紧张。

by the 1st Special District Citizens

1936年11月9日 - 第一特区市民联合会就改善当地局势向日本社区发出公开信。

1936年11月10日 - 日本纳税人协会提出特别行政区问题。

1936年11月11日 - 外交部长张群（Chang Chun）将军与日本大使川越茂（Kawagoe）先生举行第七次会晤。
